Fix `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:app regression introduced by the last review fix (26 history.test.tsx tests passed before it), e.g.:
 FAIL  packages/excalidraw/tests/history.test.tsx > history > singleplayer undo/redo > should support bidirectional bindings > should unbind rectangles from arrow on deletion and rebind on undo
AssertionError: expected null to be 'id0' // Object.is equality

- Expected: 
"id0"

+ Received: 
null

 ❯ packages/excalidraw/tests/history.test.tsx:1578:34
    1576| 
    1577|         expect(API.getUndoStack().length).toBe(4);
    1578|         expect(text.containerId).toBe(rect1.id);
       |                                  ^
    1579|         expect(rect1.boundElements).toStrictEqual([
    1580|           { id: text.id, type: "text" },
Cause: the new stampPageIds() returns SHALLOW COPIES ({ ...element, pageId }) for elements without a pageId, in updateScene and applySceneElements. Callers (tests and hosts) keep references to the element objects they passed to updateScene (e.g. `text`, `rect1`), and those references no longer live in the scene, so bindings/containerId seen through them are stale and render counts drop (snapshot `number of renders` expected 15, received 7). Fix: keep object identity. Stamp pageId IN PLACE on the passed element objects by direct assignment ((element as Mutable<ExcalidrawElement>).pageId = pageId, no version bump, exactly as Scene.replaceAllElements does), and do it at the START of updateScene / applySceneElements, BEFORE the elements reach this.store (scheduleMicroAction or commit), so the Store snapshot already holds pageId and no spurious pageId undefined -> page-1 delta is recorded. Remove stampPageIds' copying. Keep withValidActivePage/resolveActivePageId and every other change of the last round.

Fix `excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:typecheck (this error was fixed in an earlier round and came back in the last review fix):
excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx(878,7): error TS2322: Type '{ contextMenu?: { items: ContextMenuItems; top: number; left: number; } | null | undefined; showWelcomeScreen?: boolean | undefined; isLoading?: boolean | undefined; ... 97 more ...; pageViewports?: Readonly<...> | undefined; }' is not assignable to type 'Pick<AppState, "name" | "width" | "height" | "zoom" | "viewModeEnabled" | "activeTo
  Types of property 'name' are incompatible.
    Type 'string | null | undefined' is not assignable to type 'string | null'.
      Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'string | null'.
At handleRemotePagesUpdate (~line 868-881) `appState: { pages, ...switchState }` spreads switchState, a full AppState from getSwitchPageAppState, into a type whose optional fields become `| undefined`, so `name: string | null | undefined` is not assignable. Build the updateScene appState explicitly: `const nextAppState: Pick<AppState, "pages"> & Partial<Pick<AppState, "activePageId" | "scrollX" | "scrollY" | "zoom" | "pageViewports" | "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "editingGroupId">> = { pages }` and, when switching, copy only those keys from switchState. Keep the early return when the pages did not change (the review fix).
